category_fit.consequence: No APM rate reference can be built without an external TSM executor; this package is a blocker record, not an APM implementation.
category_fit.source_statement: WebRTC Audio Processing (APM): not a TSM executor; a VAD component can be evaluated separately.

non_claims: No WebRTC APM algorithm, rate actuator, time stretcher or audio output is implemented.

release_gates.requirement: Pinned, hash-verified WebRTC APM source revision or pywebrtc-audio==0.2.0 wheel/source, with Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE reviewed for the exact revision and execution approval.
A documented, tested APM API that changes rate or performs time-scale modification at the frozen 16 kHz mono 160-sample geometry.
Rights-cleared 16 kHz mono speech, music, silence, rebuffer and drift material with exact source timestamps and final partial windows.
Paired source/output duration, pitch, transient audibility and speech-preservation measurements for 1x, rate changes and the final partial window.
Measured playback buffering over 1x, rate changes, rebuffer, clock drift and the final partial window with an explicit queue/end-padding policy.
Target-device content and availability timing, memory, and callback/deadline budget for the exact workload and runtime.
Authorized listening or an approved naturalness assessment on the exact runtime and matched rate conditions.
Provider/catalog/license intake, descriptor and public-surface review, plus explicit release approval before any exposure.
